axes.concept: Operational reading of the owner-selected Pliegues de consulta; public plan information without account mutation.
axes.layout: One continuous paper with four ruled bands. Desktop uses a 240px identity column; tablet moves identity above a two-column tool list; phone uses a single column.
axes.navigation: Wrapping in-page plan index and a separate informational selection view; contextual return to sign-in or Mi cuenta; no new app destination in sibling navigation.
axes.typography: Production Geist Sans; 24px page title, 20px plan names, 22px tabular prices (20px phone), 14px tool lines, 12–13px supporting text.
axes.density: Dense grouped catalogue reading with 20px desktop band padding and 12px tool-row gaps; all cumulative tools remain visible.
axes.components: Installed Base UI/shadcn Button, Input, Skeleton; retained native language selector and account disclosure; custom semantic plan bands, index and tool lists.
axes.colour: Exact Pictures globals.css light/dark tokens. Neutral chrome and separators; existing accent marks the comparison highlight and keyboard focus. No new palette.
axes.motion: Precise 480ms horizontal band registration with 35ms offsets and ease-out (.23,1,.32,1), counter-direction 180ms index cut, quick hover/press feedback; natural/subtle profiles and reduced/still parity.
